column1: # USER RULINGS the census must consume — machine-readable, one per line.
# §516 recorded the user's NO VETO ruling in prose. The instrument never saw it,
# so the census kept emitting VETO-PENDING for six sections while the derivation
# doc said B2 was CLOSED (§546). A ruling that lives only in prose is a ruling
# A ruling here CHANGES A VERDICT; it never deletes the underlying finding. The
# Axis P candidates that raised VETO-PENDING stay visible and stay counted — the
# user overruled the disposition, not the measurement. Erasing the evidence
# would make the ruling unreviewable and its REVISIT TRIGGER unfireable.
#   kind    NO-VETO — a spec §5 veto candidate is ruled not disqualifying
#   scope   * = all subsystems, or an exact subsystem name
